messages.content:
<document id=DOC_req_years_eight>
Required: 8 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_no_dates>
Backend engineering across transactional services, most recently a
settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day. Previously worked on
payment reconciliation and inventory systems.
</document>

Rewrite the candidate summary below to match the posting requirement.

If years of experience are neither stated nor calculable, ask me for the
figure and tell me what it costs not to supply it.

response.text:
The summary does not state years of experience, and there are no dates to calculate them from, so I will not invent an “8 years” claim.

Send the actual years (or start/end dates for each backend role). Without that figure, the rewrite cannot meet the posting’s explicit 8-year requirement, and a recruiter or ATS screen is likely to drop the candidate for a missing qualifier rather than infer experience from the settlement, reconciliation, and inventory work.
